On USDCAD I am actually looking for shorts. Price just made a very big decision to engulf monthly supply. After such a important decision I think price will turn back to the DP, but I don't know when it is turning, so I am waiting for Eng south on H4 to sell into DP. Bull bars on daily chart are already getting weaker...
I was going to take a short term long trade on the return to the flip zone, but price never really reached the zone and I missed the ideal entry. I'm not going to take a trade now.

I am in the process of adjusting my trade strategy to a more simpler plan. Part of that strategy is looking for price returning for the first time to an area where price broke a significant S/R level. Look for PA at these critical flip zones to see order flow.

This is an example of a short term scalp that would have been very profitable.

If I can take these on a regular basis and only take the trades that offer the best R:R it will really help build my account.

Trying to keep it simple and logical.
